name: zarchive_list_find_payload_by_predicate
description: zArchiveList::FindPayloadByPredicate scans a circular archive list from head and returns the first payload whose predicate returns zero.
known_limits: tier S verification remains open for this helper despite existing VC coverage; this manifest records functional behavior only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48cbd0 validates null-list and empty-list null returns, circular head-first traversal from list->head, predicate calls with ECX=payload and EDX=userData, stop when predicate returns zero, payload return on match, and null return after wrapping back to head.

The native smoke builds a two-entry search path list, invokes zArchiveList_FindPayloadByPredicate through the recovered thunk with zUtil_ZRDR_StrCmpPredicate, verifies the second payload is returned for a matching path, and verifies the predicate's zero-is-match convention.
